function: Federated LSTM-DDPG agent with attention sets UAV-RIS beamforming, RIS phase shifts and power allocation to maximize sum rate and secrecy rate under attacks (pp. 4-6).
system: Reflecting RIS on a UAV, 70-130 elements, relays 35-125 IoT devices to a 4-antenna central server; single-antenna users and eavesdroppers; 20-40 attackers; 2 GHz (pp. 3-4, 7).
method: Federated LSTM actor-critic DDPG with attention, reinforcement learning; one agent per UAV-RIS, weighted parameter averaging at a server; actor LSTM 28-14-8 units, critic 40-20 (pp. 5-7).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician LoS/NLoS aerial-to-ground fading from [48], path-loss exponent 1.8, Rician factor 10, Doppler; no 3GPP, public or measured data (pp. 4, 7).
test_conditions: No separate training and testing conditions stated; default setup of 60 devices, 70 elements, 24 dBm, then sweeps of devices, elements and power (pp. 7-9).
baselines: Learned only: SecCNN [50], PPO-AO [51], DDPG-based [34], DRL-based [26], generic RL beamforming, plus LSTM-DDPG and DDPG ablations; no non-learned method plotted (pp. 7-8).
metrics: Average secrecy rate (bps/Hz), QoS satisfaction level, communication rate (Mbps), accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and AUC (Table I), convergence (pp. 8-10).
q1_support: p. 4: "We adopt the fading model from [48], which considers both LoS and Non-LoS (NLoS) links in aerial-to-ground (UAV-RIS) communication"; p. 7: "a pathloss exponent of 1.8 and a Rician factor of 10". Not met: custom Rician model, no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 7: "The simulation setup incorporates a dynamic number of IoT devices, ranging from 35 to 125." Not met: the paper sweeps devices, reflecting elements and power (Figs. 4-8, pp. 8-9) but never separates training from testing conditions or reports a model trained on one setting and applied to another.
q3_support: p. 7: "proximal policy optimization with alternating optimization (PPO-AO) algorithm for secure beamforming as in [51]". Not met: every compared method is learned (SecCNN, PPO-AO, DDPG, DRL, RL) or an ablation (LSTM-DDPG); no non-learned method is plotted, and "scenarios without RIS" (p. 8) has no curve or gain figure.
q4_support: p. 7: "The actor LSTM in the DDPG framework comprises three sequential LSTM layers with 28, 14, and 8 units, respectively." Not met: only layer sizes are given; no complexity order, operation count, parameter count or runtime anywhere.
q5_support: p. 4: "We adopt the fading model from [48]". Not met: data come from the authors' own simulator, there is no code or data link, and no public dataset is used.
notes: Area 6 by the specificity order because the links are UAV-RIS aerial-to-ground links (p. 4); area 3 would apply if UAV platforms are not counted as NTN, since the learned outputs are beamforming and phase shifts. Federated aggregation is digital (agents send parameters to a server, p. 5), so not area 7. Secrecy rate is defined as 1 - Dn/Tn (Eq. 4, p. 4) yet plotted in bps/Hz, and Table I reports classification metrics for the beamformers (p. 9). PPO-AO mixes learned PPO with alternating optimization, so there is no purely non-learned baseline.
